SEN.note: Civil-status acts are only to be added to e-Senegal later; no exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding the NIN is given.
No number given at birth is stated.
Who operates or maintains the ID system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the NIN is stated; the NIN is a portal login key.

facts.fact: Access to the e-Senegal platform, launched 24 March 2026 by SENUM SA, rests on authentication with the Numero d'Identification Nationale (NIN) carried on the biometric identity card, per Ndarinfo.

systems.system: Numero d'Identification Nationale (NIN) and biometric identity card
